facts: Settlor conveyed his residence into a trust whose sole present beneficiary is his longtime business partner, an unrelated individual. The partner will occupy the home. The deed was recorded in March 2026.

expected.notes: TRAP — a trust conveyance is not automatically excepted. The beneficiary is outside both the settlor/spouse test of (g)(i) and the relative class of (g)(ii). Expected uncapping. [FACTS TIGHTENED 2026-08-04, systematic audit: the statute defines 'residential real property' as property CLASSIFIED as such under section 34c, and the family/trust exceptions in (7)(u), (7)(g)(ii) and (7)(v) all begin 'Beginning December 31, 2014'. Cases that said only 'residential parcel' with no date left the model unable to tell (7)(t) from (7)(u) — which is what made TD-FAMRES-003 fail before it was fixed the same way. Classification and a transfer date are now stated wherever they are load-bearing. The legal question each case tests is unchanged.]
